mapper.select: SELECT o.id AS order_id, o.order_number AS order_number, o.status AS status, COALESCE(u.phone_number, g.phone_number) AS recipient_phone_number, e.event_end_at AS expo_end_at FROM ticket_orders o LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = o.member_user_id LEFT JOIN guest_order_infos g ON g.ticket_order_id = o.id LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT oi.ticket_product_id FROM ticket_order_items oi WHERE oi.ticket_order_id = o.id ORDER BY oi.id LIMIT 1 ) first_item ON TRUE LEFT JOIN ticket_products tp ON tp.id = first_item.ticket_product_id LEFT JOIN expos e ON e.id = tp.expo_id WHERE o.id = #{ticketOrderId}

SELECT oi.id AS order_item_id, tp.expo_id AS expo_id, oi.quantity AS quantity FROM ticket_order_items oi JOIN ticket_products tp ON tp.id = oi.ticket_product_id WHERE oi.ticket_order_id = #{ticketOrderId} ORDER BY oi.id
SELECT count(*) FROM issued_tickets it JOIN ticket_order_items oi ON oi.id = it.ticket_order_item_id WHERE oi.ticket_order_id = #{ticketOrderId}
